Audit status is generated from the read-only source payload. Counts represent the rolling 30-day signal inventory, not executed trades or P&L. Profit, win rate, expectancy, drawdown, commissions and realized performance are not calculated. MT5 execution history and Shadow A/B/C/D are not connected.
